# CediWise financial literacy

> Short, Ghana-specific money lessons: MTN MoMo, Vodafone Cash, Treasury Bills, GSE, banks, PAYE, SSNIT. Free in the CediWise app.

Markdown version: https://www.cediwise.app/financial-literacy.md

## Topics

- Budgeting and the 50/30/20 rule for Ghanaian incomes
- Savings, emergency funds, bank savings versus Treasury Bills
- Mobile money: how MoMo works, fees, limits, avoiding overpayment
- Fraud and safety: scams, phishing, fake investment pitches
